- **Motion audit**: `ds-motion-audit.md` cobre animações CSS; este guia cobre video como motion pattern
- **design-mappings.yaml**: termos "video de fundo", "hero com video", "fundo animado" mapeados


## Referência: references/squad/data/knowledge/w3c-dtcg-spec-reference.md

# W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) v1.0 — Operational Reference

**Source:** W3C Design Tokens Community Group stable spec (October 28, 2025)
**Purpose:** Quick reference for implementing tokens in DTCG format

---

## Format Structure

Every token has three required properties:

```json
{
  "token-name": {
    "$value": "<the value>",
    "$type": "<type identifier>",
    "$description": "What this token is for"
  }
}
```

- `$value` — The actual design value
- `$type` — One of the supported types (see below)
- `$description` — Human/AI-readable purpose explanation

---

## Supported Types

| Type | Example $value | Notes |
|------|---------------|-------|
| `color` | `"#0066CC"` or `"oklch(0.65 0.15 250)"` | Hex, RGB, HSL, OKLCH |
| `dimension` | `"16px"` or `"1rem"` | Spacing, sizing, radius |
| `fontFamily` | `"Inter, sans-serif"` | Font stack |
| `fontWeight` | `400` or `"bold"` | Numeric or named |
| `duration` | `"200ms"` | Animation timing |
| `cubicBezier` | `[0.4, 0, 0.2, 1]` | Easing curve (4 numbers) |
| `number` | `1.5` | Unitless numbers (line-height, opacity) |
| `strokeStyle` | `"solid"` or object | Border style |
| `border` | `{"color": "...", "width": "...", "style": "..."}` | Composite |
| `transition` | `{"duration": "...", "delay": "...", "timingFunction": [...]}` | Composite |
| `shadow` | `{"color": "...", "offsetX": "...", "offsetY": "...", "blur": "...", "spread": "..."}` | Composite |
| `gradient` | Array of stops | Linear/radial |
| `typography` | `{"fontFamily": "...", "fontSize": "...", "fontWeight": ..., "lineHeight": ...}` | Composite |

---

## Group Nesting

Tokens are organized in groups using nesting:

```json
{
  "color": {
    "$type": "color",
    "primary": {
      "$value": "#0066CC",
      "$description": "Primary brand color"
    },
    "secondary": {
      "$value": "#6B7280",
      "$description": "Secondary/muted color"
    }
  },
  "spacing": {
    "$type": "dimension",
    "xs": { "$value": "4px" },
    "sm": { "$value": "8px" },
    "md": { "$value": "16px" },
    "lg": { "$value": "24px" },
    "xl": { "$value": "32px" }
  }
}
```

Setting `$type` on a group applies it to all children.

---

## Mode Architecture

Modes (light/dark/high-contrast) use token aliases:

```json
{
  "color": {
    "surface": {
      "$type": "color",
      "$value": "{color.white}",
      "$extensions": {
        "mode": {
          "dark": "{color.gray-900}",
          "high-contrast": "{color.black}"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Pattern:** Base value = light mode. Extensions define overrides per mode.

---

## Aliases (References)

Tokens can reference other tokens using `{}` syntax:

```json
{
  "color": {
    "brand": { "$value": "#0066CC", "$type": "color" },
    "action-primary": { "$value": "{color.brand}", "$type": "color" }
  }
}
```

This creates semantic layers: primitive → semantic → component tokens.

---

## Tooling Ecosystem

| Tool | Role | DTCG Support |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Style Dictionary 4.x** | Token transformation/export | Full v1.0 |
| **Tokens Studio** | Figma plugin for token management | Full v1.0 |
| **Terrazzo** | CLI token compiler | Full v1.0 |
| **Figma Variables** | Design tool native tokens | Partial (export via plugin) |
| **Penpot** | Open-source design tool | Full v1.0 |

---

## Migration from Proprietary Formats

### From Style Dictionary v3 format
- Add `$` prefix to `value` → `$value`
- Add `$type` to each token or group
- Move `type` from nested `attributes` to top-level `$type`

### From Figma Variables
- Export via Tokens Studio plugin in DTCG format
- Map Figma collections to DTCG groups
- Map Figma modes to `$extensions.mode`

### From custom JSON/YAML
- Restructure to `$value`/`$type`/`$description` format
- Normalize types to DTCG supported types
- Add group hierarchy


## Referência: references/squad/data/knowledge/wcag-compliance-guide.md

# WCAG Compliance Guide

**Standard:** WCAG 2.1 Level AA (minimum), AAA target
**Purpose:** Ensure design system components meet accessibility standards
**Reference:** https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/

---

## Quick Reference: WCAG AA Requirements

### Color Contrast

**Text:**
- Normal text (< 18px): ≥ 4.5:1 contrast ratio
- Large text (≥ 18px or bold ≥ 14px): ≥ 3:1 contrast ratio

**Non-Text (UI components):**
- Icons, buttons, form borders: ≥ 3:1 contrast ratio

**Testing:**
```bash
# Use browser dev tools or:
npm install -g pa11y
pa11y --standard WCAG2AA http://localhost:3000
```

### Keyboard Navigation

**Required:**
- All interactive elements accessible via Tab key
- Logical tab order (top → bottom, left → right)
- Enter/Space activates buttons
- Arrow keys for radio groups, menus
- Escape closes modals, dropdowns

**Focus Indicators:**
- Visible focus outline (≥ 3:1 contrast)
- Never `outline: none` without replacement

```css
/* Good */
button:focus {
    outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Bad */
button:focus {
    outline: none;  /* ❌ Removes keyboard navigation indicator */
}
```

### ARIA Attributes

**When to use:**
- Custom widgets (not semantic HTML)
- Dynamic content updates
- Complex interactions

**Common ARIA:**
```html
<!-- Button with icon only -->
<button aria-label="Close dialog">
    <CloseIcon />
</button>

<!-- Loading state -->
<div aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">
    Loading...
</div>

<!-- Expanded state -->
<button
    aria-expanded="false"
    aria-controls="menu"
>
    Menu
</button>

<!-- Disabled -->
<button disabled aria-disabled="true">
    Submit
</button>
```

---

## WCAG AAA (Target, not required)

**Enhanced Requirements:**
- Text contrast: ≥ 7:1 (normal), ≥ 4.5:1 (large)
- No images of text
- Enhanced visual presentation (line height ≥ 1.5)

---

## Component-Specific Guidelines

### Buttons

```tsx
// ✅ Good
<button
    onClick={handleClick}
    disabled={isDisabled}
    aria-disabled={isDisabled}
    aria-label="Save changes"
>
    Save
</button>

// ❌ Bad
<div onClick={handleClick}>  // Not keyboard accessible
    Save
</div>
```

### Forms

```tsx
// ✅ Good
<label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
<input
    id="email"
    type="email"
    required
    aria-required="true"
    aria-invalid={hasError}
    aria-describedby="email-error"
/>
{hasError && (
    <span id="email-error" role="alert">
        Invalid email format
    </span>
)}

// ❌ Bad
<input placeholder="Email" />  // No label
```

### Modals

```tsx
// ✅ Good
<div
    role="dialog"
    aria-modal="true"
    aria-labelledby="dialog-title"
>
    <h2 id="dialog-title">Confirm Action</h2>
    <p>Are you sure?</p>
    <button onClick={onConfirm}>Yes</button>
    <button onClick={onCancel}>No</button>
</div>

// Focus trap: Tab cycles within modal
// Escape closes modal
```

---

## Testing Checklist

### Automated Testing

```bash
# Install tools
npm install --save-dev @testing-library/jest-dom
npm install --save-dev jest-axe

# Test example
import { axe } from 'jest-axe';

test('Button is accessible', async () => {
    const { container } = render(<Button>Click me</Button>);
    const results = await axe(container);
    expect(results).toHaveNoViolations();
});
```

### Manual Testing

- [ ] Navigate entire app with keyboard only (no mouse)
- [ ] Test with screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver)
- [ ] Zoom to 200% - all content still accessible
- [ ] Check color contrast with dev tools
- [ ] Test with high contrast mode

---

## Common Violations & Fixes

### Violation 1: Missing Alt Text

```tsx
// ❌ Bad
<img src="logo.png" />

// ✅ Good
<img src="logo.png" alt="Company logo" />

// ✅ Good (decorative)
<img src="decoration.png" alt="" />
```

### Violation 2: Low Contrast

```css
/* ❌ Bad */
.text {
    color: #999;           /* 2.8:1 contrast */
    background: #fff;
}

/* ✅ Good */
.text {
    color: #666;           /* 5.7:1 contrast ✓ */
    background: #fff;
}
```

### Violation 3: Click-Only Elements

```tsx
// ❌ Bad
<div onClick={handleClick}>Click me</div>

// ✅ Good
<button onClick={handleClick}>Click me</button>

// ✅ Good (if div required)
<div
    role="button"
    tabIndex={0}
    onClick={handleClick}
    onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
            handleClick();
        }
    }}
>
    Click me
</div>
```

---

## Resources

- **WCAG Quick Reference:** https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/quickref/
- **ARIA Authoring Practices:** https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/
- **axe DevTools:** Browser extension for automated testing
- **WAVE:** Web accessibility evaluation tool

---

## Design System Enforcement

**All components MUST:**
- Pass axe automated tests
- Have ≥ 4.5:1 text contrast
- Be keyboard navigable
- Have visible focus indicators
- Include proper ARIA attributes
- Be tested with screen readers

**Non-negotiable. Brad says: "Accessibility is quality."**

```text
when_to_use: display when list/table has no data
example: <EmptyState className="..." />
a11y: semantic section element, keyboard navigable

## Timeline
import: @/components/ui/timeline
props: items, orientation, className
when_to_use: display chronological events or steps
example: <Timeline className="..." />
a11y: semantic ol element, keyboard navigable

## RichTextEditor
import: @/components/ui/rich-text
props: value, onChange, toolbar, className
when_to_use: formatted text editing with markdown/WYSIWYG
example: <RichTextEditor className="..." />
a11y: semantic div[contenteditable] element, keyboard navigable
```

## Referência: references/squad/data/motion-map-schema.json

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "motion-map-v1",
  "title": "Motion Map Schema",
  "description": "Contrato formal entre extraction (Fase 3) e replication (Fase 4) do Kinetic Design System. Define a estrutura do motion-map.json gerado pelo pipeline ds-motion-extraction e consumido por ds-kinetic-replication.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["$schema", "metadata", "entries"],
  "properties": {
    "$schema": {
      "type": "string",
      "const": "motion-map-v1",
      "description": "Versao do schema. Deve ser 'motion-map-v1'."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/Metadata"
    },
    "entries": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Lista de animacoes e interacoes extraidas, cada uma classificada contra o primitives registry.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Entry"
      }
    },
    "token_recommendations": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/TokenRecommendations"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "$defs": {
    "ConfidenceLevel": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["ALTA", "MEDIA", "BAIXA"],
      "description": "Nivel de confianca da classificacao. ALTA (>80%): match 1:1 de propriedades. MEDIA (50-80%): composicao provavel ou delta >50ms. BAIXA (<50%): sem match claro ou scroll-driven parcial."
    },
    "ExtractionScope": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["full", "css-only", "cdp-only", "interactions"],
      "description": "Escopo da extracao executada."
    },
    "AnimationSource": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["css", "cdp", "interaction"],
      "description": "Origem da captura: css (CSSOM static), cdp (CDP Animation Domain runtime), interaction (hover/active/focus diff)."
    },
    "AnimationType": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["CSSAnimation", "CSSTransition", "WebAnimation"],
      "description": "Tipo de animacao conforme Web Animations API."
    },
    "Metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Metadados da extracao: URL fonte, data, escopo, resumo de classificacao.",
      "required": ["source_url", "extraction_date", "extraction_scope", "total_entries"],
      "properties": {
        "source_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "uri",
          "description": "URL de onde as animacoes foram extraidas."
        },
        "extraction_date": {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "description": "Data/hora da extracao em ISO 8601."
        },
        "extraction_scope": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ExtractionScope"
        },
        "playwright_version": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Versao do Playwright usada na extracao."
        },
        "phases_completed": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "integer",
            "minimum": 1,
            "maximum": 5
          },
          "description": "Fases da extracao completadas (1-5)."
        },
        "total_entries": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Total de entries (animacoes + interacoes) no mapa."
        },
        "classification_summary": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ClassificationSummary"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "ClassificationSummary": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Resumo quantitativo das classificacoes por camada do registry.",
      "properties": {
        "primitives": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 },
          "description": "Contagem por primitivo (ex: { fadeIn: 12, slideIn: 8 })."
        },
        "compositions": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 },
          "description": "Contagem por composicao (ex: { reveal: 5, heroEntrance: 1 })."
        },
        "choreographies": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0 },
          "description": "Contagem por coreografia (ex: { staggerGrid: 2 })."
        },
        "unclassified": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Total de animacoes sem match no registry."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Entry": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Uma animacao ou interacao extraida de um elemento do DOM.",
      "required": ["id", "selector", "animation_type", "source", "properties", "classification"],
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^(anim|int)-\\d{3,}$",
          "description": "Identificador unico da entry (anim-001 para animacoes, int-001 para interacoes)."
        },
        "selector": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "CSS selector do elemento animado (ex: 'section.hero > h1')."
        },
        "element_tag": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Tag HTML do elemento (ex: 'h1', 'button', 'div')."
        },
        "animation_type": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AnimationType"
        },
        "source": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AnimationSource"
        },
        "trigger": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["load", "scroll", "hover", "active", "focus", "intersection"],
          "description": "Evento que dispara a animacao."
        },
        "properties": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AnimatedProperties"
        },
        "classification": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Classification"
        },
        "token_mapping": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/TokenMapping"
        },
        "raw_data": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RawData"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "AnimatedProperties": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Propriedades CSS animadas extraidas do elemento.",
      "properties": {
        "css_properties": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string" },
          "description": "Lista de propriedades CSS animadas (ex: ['opacity', 'transform'])."
        },
        "duration_ms": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Duracao da animacao em milissegundos."
        },
        "delay_ms": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Delay da animacao em milissegundos."
        },
        "easing": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Funcao de easing (ex: 'cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1)', 'ease-out', 'linear')."
        },
        "iterations": {
          "type": ["number", "string"],
          "description": "Numero de iteracoes. 'infinite' para loops.",
          "examples": [1, "infinite"]
        },
        "direction": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["normal", "reverse", "alternate", "alternate-reverse"],
          "description": "Direcao da animacao."
        },
        "fill": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": ["none", "forwards", "backwards", "both"],
          "description": "Fill mode da animacao."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Classification": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Classificacao da animacao contra o primitives registry do design system.",
      "required": ["primitive_match", "confidence"],
      "properties": {
        "primitive_match": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "fadeIn", "fadeOut", "slideIn", "slideOut", "scaleIn",
            "blur", "rotate", "clipReveal", "colorShift", "parallax",
            "unclassified"
          ],
          "description": "Primitivo do registry que melhor corresponde, ou 'unclassified' se nenhum match."
        },
        "confidence": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ConfidenceLevel"
        },
        "confidence_reason": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Explicacao do nivel de confianca (ex: 'opacity + translateY matches slideIn+fadeIn pattern')."
        },
        "composition": {
          "type": ["string", "null"],
          "description": "ID da composicao se a animacao faz parte de uma (ex: 'reveal', 'heroEntrance'). null se nao e composicao.",
          "examples": ["reveal", "heroEntrance", "parallaxLayer", null]
        },
        "choreography": {
          "type": ["string", "null"],
          "description": "ID da coreografia se a animacao faz parte de uma (ex: 'staggerGrid', 'scrollTimeline'). null se nao e coreografia.",
          "examples": ["staggerGrid", "scrollTimeline", null]
        },
        "matched_properties": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "string" },
          "description": "Propriedades CSS que fundamentaram o match (ex: ['opacity', 'transform.translateY'])."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "TokenMapping": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Mapeamento dos valores extraidos para tokens do motion-tokens-schema.",
      "properties": {
        "duration_token": {
          "type": ["string", "null"],
          "description": "Token de duracao mais proximo (ex: 'motion.duration.moderate'). null se nenhum match.",
          "examples": ["motion.duration.base", "motion.duration.moderate", "motion.duration.slow"]
        },
        "duration_delta_ms": {
          "type": "number",
          "description": "Diferenca em ms entre o valor extraido e o token mapeado. <50ms para ALTA confianca."
        },
        "easing_token": {
          "type": ["string", "null"],
          "description": "Token de easing mais proximo (ex: 'motion.easing.ease-out'). null se nenhum match.",
          "examples": ["motion.easing.ease-out", "motion.easing.ease-in-out", "motion.easing.spring"]
        },
        "easing_delta": {
          "type": "number",
          "description": "Distancia euclidiana entre curva extraida e curva do token. <0.05 para ALTA confianca."
        },
        "stagger_token": {
          "type": ["string", "null"],
          "description": "Token de stagger se detectado pattern de delay crescente (ex: 'motion.stagger.base'). null se nao aplicavel.",
          "examples": ["motion.stagger.subtle", "motion.stagger.base", null]
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "RawData": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Dados brutos para debug: keyframes, computed values, CDP payload.",
      "properties": {
        "keyframes": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Keyframe"
          },
          "description": "Array de keyframes extraidos da animacao."
        },
        "computed_values": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": { "type": "string" },
          "description": "Mapa de propriedade -> valor computado antes da animacao (getComputedStyle snapshot)."
        },
        "cdp_payload": {
          "type": "object",
          "description": "Payload bruto do CDP Animation.animationStarted event. Preservado para debug e re-classificacao.",
          "properties": {
            "animation_id": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "ID da animacao no CDP."
            },
            "name": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Nome da animacao (@keyframes name ou ''  para transitions)."
            },
            "type": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Tipo CDP: CSSTransition, CSSAnimation, WebAnimation."
            },
            "source": {
              "type": "object",
              "description": "Source object do CDP com timing details.",
              "properties": {
                "delay": { "type": "number" },
                "endDelay": { "type": "number" },
                "duration": { "type": "number" },
                "iterationStart": { "type": "number" },
                "iterations": { "type": "number" },
                "fill": { "type": "string" },
                "direction": { "type": "string" },
                "easing": { "type": "string" }
              },
              "additionalProperties": true
            }
          },
          "additionalProperties": true
        },
        "interaction_diff": {
          "type": "object",
          "description": "Diff de propriedades antes/depois de interacao (hover, active, focus).",
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "before": { "type": "string" },
              "after": { "type": "string" }
            },
            "required": ["before", "after"],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "Keyframe": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Um keyframe individual de uma animacao.",
      "required": ["offset"],
      "properties": {
        "offset": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "maximum": 1,
          "description": "Posicao do keyframe (0.0 a 1.0)."
        },
        "easing": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Easing deste keyframe para o proximo."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string",
        "description": "Propriedades CSS animadas neste keyframe (ex: opacity: '0', transform: 'translateY(20px)')."
      }
    },
    "TokenRecommendations": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Recomendacoes de tokens derivadas dos valores extraidos via clustering.",
      "properties": {
        "duration_clusters": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/DurationCluster"
          },
          "description": "Clusters de duracao encontrados nos dados extraidos."
        },
        "easing_clusters": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/EasingCluster"
          },
          "description": "Clusters de easing encontrados nos dados extraidos."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "DurationCluster": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Um cluster de duracoes similares encontrado na extracao.",
      "required": ["centroid_ms", "count"],
      "properties": {
        "centroid_ms": {
          "type": "number",
          "minimum": 0,
          "description": "Centroide do cluster em milissegundos."
        },
        "count": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "description": "Quantidade de animacoes neste cluster."
        },
        "suggested_token": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Token sugerido do motion-tokens-schema (ex: 'motion.duration.base')."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "EasingCluster": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "Um cluster de easings similares encontrado na extracao.",
      "required": ["centroid", "count"],
      "properties": {
        "centroid": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": { "type": "number" },
          "minItems": 4,
          "maxItems": 4,
          "description": "Centroide cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2]."
        },
        "count": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "description": "Quantidade de animacoes neste cluster."
        },
        "suggested_token": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Token sugerido do motion-tokens-schema (ex: 'motion.easing.ease-out')."
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  }
}
```


## Referência: references/squad/data/motion-primitives-registry.yaml

```yaml
# Motion Primitives Registry — Kinetic Design System
#
# Catalogs the 10 animation primitives, 7 compositions, and 5 choreographies
# that form the building blocks of the motion layer.
#
# Source: docs/research/2026-03-21-kinetic-design-system/03-recommendations.md
# Version: 1.0.0
# Created: 2026-03-22

registry_version: "1.0.0"
description: >
  Registry of motion primitives (atomic animations), compositions (combined primitives),
  and choreographies (orchestrated multi-element sequences). Each entry defines the
  CSS and Framer Motion implementation pattern, parameters, and accessibility notes.

# =============================================================================
# LAYER 2: PRIMITIVES (10 atomic animation effects)
# =============================================================================
primitives:
  - id: fadeIn
    name: Fade In
    description: "Opacity transition from 0 to 1"
    css_properties: ["opacity"]
    params:
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes fadeIn {
        from { opacity: 0; }
        to { opacity: 1; }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { opacity: 0 }, animate: { opacity: 1 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "keep"
      fallback: "No change needed — opacity-only transitions are safe for vestibular disorders"
      rationale: "No spatial movement, no vestibular risk. Preserves orientation cue."
    val_head_purpose: ["direct-attention", "orient"]

  - id: fadeOut
    name: Fade Out
    description: "Opacity transition from 1 to 0"
    css_properties: ["opacity"]
    params:
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes fadeOut {
        from { opacity: 1; }
        to { opacity: 0; }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { opacity: 1 }, exit: { opacity: 0 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "keep"
      fallback: "No change needed — opacity-only transitions are safe for vestibular disorders"
      rationale: "No spatial movement, no vestibular risk. Preserves exit orientation cue."
    val_head_purpose: ["orient"]

  - id: slideIn
    name: Slide In
    description: "Transform translateX/Y from offset to 0"
    css_properties: ["transform"]
    params:
      direction: "up | down | left | right"
      distance: "px value (default: 40px)"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes slideIn {
        from { transform: translateY(var(--slide-distance, 40px)); }
        to { transform: translateY(0); }
      }
    linear_css_pattern:
      description: "slideIn with physics-based spring easing via CSS linear()"
      when: "easing is spring or bounce — provides realistic overshoot/bounce feel"
      pattern: |
        .slide-in-spring {
          animation: slideIn var(--motion-duration-moderate) cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
        }
        @supports (animation-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) {
          .slide-in-spring {
            animation-timing-function: var(--motion-easing-spring);
            /* Resolves to linear() spring curve when token system outputs linear() */
          }
        }
        .slide-in-bounce {
          animation: slideIn var(--motion-duration-moderate) cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.27, 1.55) both;
        }
        @supports (animation-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) {
          .slide-in-bounce {
            animation-timing-function: var(--motion-easing-bounce);
          }
        }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { y: 40 }, animate: { y: 0 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "fadeIn with 100ms ease-out (remove transform, keep opacity transition)"
      rationale: "Functional for navigation — reduce distance to 0, keep opacity cue"
    val_head_purpose: ["orient", "direct-attention"]

  - id: slideOut
    name: Slide Out
    description: "Transform from 0 to offset translateX/Y"
    css_properties: ["transform"]
    params:
      direction: "up | down | left | right"
      distance: "px value (default: 40px)"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes slideOut {
        from { transform: translateY(0); }
        to { transform: translateY(var(--slide-distance, -40px)); }
      }
    linear_css_pattern:
      description: "slideOut with physics-based spring easing via CSS linear()"
      when: "easing is spring — exit with natural deceleration overshoot"
      pattern: |
        .slide-out-spring {
          animation: slideOut var(--motion-duration-base) cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
        }
        @supports (animation-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) {
          .slide-out-spring {
            animation-timing-function: var(--motion-easing-spring);
          }
        }
    framer_pattern: |
      { exit: { y: -40 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "fadeOut with 100ms ease-in (remove transform, keep opacity transition)"
      rationale: "Functional for navigation — reduce distance to 0, keep opacity cue"
    val_head_purpose: ["orient"]

  - id: scaleIn
    name: Scale In
    description: "Transform scale from reduced to 1"
    css_properties: ["transform"]
    params:
      from: "scale value (default: 0.8)"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes scaleIn {
        from { transform: scale(var(--scale-from, 0.8)); }
        to { transform: scale(1); }
      }
    linear_css_pattern:
      description: "scaleIn with physics-based spring easing via CSS linear()"
      when: "easing is spring — provides elastic pop-in feel for modals, popovers, CTAs"
      pattern: |
        .scale-in-spring {
          animation: scaleIn var(--motion-duration-moderate) cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) both;
        }
        @supports (animation-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) {
          .scale-in-spring {
            animation-timing-function: var(--motion-easing-spring);
          }
        }
        .scale-in-bounce {
          animation: scaleIn var(--motion-duration-moderate) cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.27, 1.55) both;
        }
        @supports (animation-timing-function: linear(0, 1)) {
          .scale-in-bounce {
            animation-timing-function: var(--motion-easing-bounce);
          }
        }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { scale: 0.8 }, animate: { scale: 1 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Scale range reduced to 0.95→1 with 100ms ease-out (minimal, low vestibular risk)"
      rationale: "Subtle scale is low-risk — reduce range rather than remove entirely"
    val_head_purpose: ["direct-attention", "feedback"]

  - id: blur
    name: Blur
    description: "Filter blur from amount to 0 (reveal)"
    css_properties: ["filter"]
    params:
      amount: "px blur value (default: 8px)"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes blurReveal {
        from { filter: blur(var(--blur-amount, 8px)); }
        to { filter: blur(0); }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { filter: 'blur(8px)' }, animate: { filter: 'blur(0px)' } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Blur amount reduced to 4px with 100ms ease-out (less visual complexity)"
      rationale: "Blur is focus-direction, not spatial motion — safe to reduce, not remove"
    val_head_purpose: ["direct-attention"]

  - id: rotate
    name: Rotate
    description: "Transform rotate by degrees"
    css_properties: ["transform"]
    params:
      degrees: "rotation degrees"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
      easing: "{motion.easing.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes rotate {
        from { transform: rotate(var(--rotate-from, 0deg)); }
        to { transform: rotate(var(--rotate-to, 360deg)); }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { animate: { rotate: 360 } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static position, no rotation. opacity: 1 instant."
      rationale: "Decorative — rotation is high vestibular risk, especially in loops"
    val_head_purpose: ["feedback", "brand"]

  - id: clipReveal
    name: Clip Reveal
    description: "clip-path transition from clipped to fully visible"
    css_properties: ["clip-path"]
    params:
      direction: "top | bottom | left | right | circle"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      @keyframes clipReveal {
        from { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); }
        to { clip-path: inset(0); }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { initial: { clipPath: 'inset(0 0 100% 0)' }, animate: { clipPath: 'inset(0)' } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Replace with fadeIn 100ms ease-out (remove clip-path, keep opacity reveal)"
      rationale: "Clip-path motion is moderate risk — replace with simpler opacity transition"
    val_head_purpose: ["direct-attention", "brand"]

  - id: colorShift
    name: Color Shift
    description: "Color or background-color transition"
    css_properties: ["color", "background-color"]
    params:
      from: "color value"
      to: "color value"
      duration: "{motion.duration.*}"
    css_pattern: |
      .color-shift {
        transition: color var(--motion-feedback-duration) var(--motion-feedback-easing),
                    background-color var(--motion-feedback-duration) var(--motion-feedback-easing);
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      { animate: { backgroundColor: '#target' } }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "keep"
      fallback: "No change needed — color transitions involve no spatial movement"
      rationale: "Color changes are safe. Preserves feedback and brand cues."
    val_head_purpose: ["feedback", "brand"]

  - id: parallax
    name: Parallax
    description: "Transform translateY driven by scroll position at reduced speed"
    css_properties: ["transform"]
    params:
      speed: "parallax factor (0.1 to 0.9)"
      direction: "vertical | horizontal"
    css_pattern: |
      .parallax {
        animation: parallaxMove linear;
        animation-timeline: scroll();
      }
      @keyframes parallaxMove {
        from { transform: translateY(0); }
        to { transform: translateY(calc(var(--parallax-speed, 0.5) * -100px)); }
      }
    framer_pattern: |
      const { scrollYProgress } = useScroll();
      const y = useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [0, -200]);
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static position, no transform. Content visible at default position."
      rationale: "Decorative — continuous scroll-driven motion is #1 vestibular trigger"
    val_head_purpose: ["orient", "brand"]

# =============================================================================
# LAYER 3: COMPOSITIONS (combined primitives)
# =============================================================================
compositions:
  - id: reveal
    name: Reveal
    description: "Section entrance combining fadeIn + slideIn + clipReveal"
    primitives: [fadeIn, slideIn, clipReveal]
    use_case: "Section entry on scroll"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.scroll-reveal}"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static — content visible immediately, no animation. opacity: 1, no clip-path, no transform."
      rationale: "Scroll-triggered composition with spatial movement (slideIn + clipReveal). Remove entirely to avoid vestibular risk from combined motion."

  - id: heroEntrance
    name: Hero Entrance
    description: "Hero section entrance: scaleIn + fadeIn + blur (sequenced)"
    primitives: [scaleIn, fadeIn, blur]
    use_case: "Hero section above-the-fold"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.hero}"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "fadeIn only with 100ms ease-out. No scale, no blur. Content appears with simple opacity transition."
      rationale: "Hero entrance is functional (orients user to primary content). Remove scale/blur to eliminate vestibular risk, keep fadeIn as safe orientation cue."

  - id: parallaxLayer
    name: Parallax Layer
    description: "Parallax combined with fadeIn on scroll"
    primitives: [parallax, fadeIn]
    use_case: "Background/foreground layer depth"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.scroll-reveal}"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static position — no parallax transform, no animation. Content visible at default position, opacity: 1."
      rationale: "Parallax is the #1 vestibular trigger. Continuous scroll-driven motion must be completely removed."

  - id: magneticHover
    name: Magnetic Hover
    description: "Subtle scale + cursor-driven translate"
    primitives: [scaleIn, parallax]
    use_case: "Interactive buttons and CTAs"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.feedback}"
    technique: "cursor-driven"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Disable cursor-driven translate entirely. Keep only subtle scale(1.02) on hover as static CSS transition."
      rationale: "Cursor-following motion creates floating sensation — high vestibular risk. Scale-only hover is safe."

  - id: tiltCard
    name: Tilt Card
    description: "3D rotate driven by cursor position + subtle scale"
    primitives: [rotate, scaleIn]
    use_case: "Card hover with 3D perspective"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.feedback}"
    technique: "cursor-driven"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Disable 3D rotation and cursor tracking completely. Static card with no transform."
      rationale: "3D rotation on two axes driven by cursor is high vestibular risk. No safe reduction possible — must remove entirely."

  - id: textReveal
    name: Text Reveal
    description: "fadeIn + slideIn with stagger per char/word/line"
    primitives: [fadeIn, slideIn]
    use_case: "Title and headline reveals"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.enter}"
    granularity: ["char", "word", "line"]
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "No stagger — all text appears simultaneously with fadeIn 150ms ease-out. No slideIn transform."
      rationale: "Text reveal is functional (directs attention to headings). Remove stagger and slide, keep simultaneous fade as safe orientation cue."

  - id: glassmorph
    name: Glassmorphism
    description: "Backdrop blur + fadeIn + colorShift for overlay effects"
    primitives: [blur, fadeIn, colorShift]
    use_case: "Overlays, modals with glass effect"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.enter}"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Instant backdrop-filter: blur (no animation). fadeIn 100ms ease-out for overlay. No colorShift animation."
      rationale: "Overlay entrance is functional (directs attention to modal). Keep instant blur + quick fade for orientation, remove animated transitions."

  - id: skeleton-pulse
    name: Skeleton Pulse
    description: "Loading placeholder with pulsing opacity loop combining fadeIn + fadeOut"
    primitives: [fadeIn, fadeOut]
    use_case: "Skeleton loading states — content placeholder pulse"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.feedback}"
    css_pattern: |
      .skeleton-pulse {
        --skeleton-bg: var(--color-skeleton, #e0e0e0);
        background-color: var(--skeleton-bg);
        animation: skeletonPulse var(--motion-duration-gentle, 1.5s) var(--motion-easing-standard, ease-in-out) infinite;
      }
      @keyframes skeletonPulse {
        0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
        50% { opacity: 0.4; }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .skeleton-pulse {
          animation: none;
          background-color: var(--skeleton-bg);
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Static background-color — no animation. Solid skeleton placeholder visible without pulsing."
      rationale: "Pulse is functional (communicates loading state) but looping opacity can cause discomfort. Static placeholder preserves loading affordance without motion."

  - id: skeleton-shimmer
    name: Skeleton Shimmer
    description: "Loading placeholder with sliding gradient shimmer combining slideIn + colorShift"
    primitives: [slideIn, colorShift]
    use_case: "Skeleton loading states — content placeholder shimmer"
    semantic_token: "{motion.semantic.feedback}"
    css_pattern: |
      .skeleton-shimmer {
        --shimmer-base: var(--color-skeleton, #e0e0e0);
        --shimmer-highlight: var(--color-skeleton-highlight, #f5f5f5);
        background: linear-gradient(
          90deg,
          var(--shimmer-base) 25%,
          var(--shimmer-highlight) 50%,
          var(--shimmer-base) 75%
        );
        background-size: 200% 100%;
        animation: skeletonShimmer var(--motion-duration-gentle, 1.5s) var(--motion-easing-standard, ease-in-out) infinite;
      }
      @keyframes skeletonShimmer {
        0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
        100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        .skeleton-shimmer {
          animation: none;
          background: var(--shimmer-base);
          background-size: 100% 100%;
        }
      }
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Static solid background-color — no animation, no gradient movement. Solid skeleton placeholder visible."
      rationale: "Shimmer involves continuous spatial movement (gradient sliding). Static placeholder preserves loading affordance without vestibular risk from looping motion."

# =============================================================================
# LAYER 4: CHOREOGRAPHIES (orchestrated multi-element sequences)
# =============================================================================
choreographies:
  - id: staggerGrid
    name: Stagger Grid
    description: "Grid items enter with escalating stagger delay"
    technique: "Framer Motion staggerChildren + CSS animation-delay"
    trigger: "viewport-entry"
    stagger_token: "{motion.stagger.*}"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "No stagger — all items appear simultaneously with fadeIn 150ms ease-out. stagger-delay: 0ms."
      rationale: "Stagger is functional (reduces cognitive load by sequencing). In reduced mode, show all at once with simple fade to avoid prolonged motion."

  - id: scrollTimeline
    name: Scroll Timeline
    description: "Sequence of effects bound to scroll position"
    technique: "GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline with scrub"
    trigger: "scroll-position"
    lenis_pattern:
      description: "Lenis smooth scroll + velocity data feeding GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline"
      velocity_config:
        lerp: 0.1
        duration: 1.2
        smoothWheel: true
      integration: |
        // Lenis provides smooth, normalized scroll that feeds ScrollTrigger
        const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, duration: 1.2, smoothWheel: true, autoRaf: true })
        lenis.on("scroll", ScrollTrigger.update)

        // Velocity-driven timeline scrub intensity
        lenis.on("scroll", ({ velocity }) => {
          // Faster scroll → scrub responds proportionally
          // Lenis normalizes scroll velocity across devices (trackpad, wheel, touch)
        })

        const tl = gsap.timeline({
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: ".section", scrub: 1, pin: true }
        })
      benefits:
        - "Smooth, predictable scroll velocity across all input devices"
        - "Eliminates janky scroll-linked animation on trackpads"
        - "Velocity data enables dynamic scrub sensitivity"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static — all content visible at default positions, no scroll-driven animation. Elements display in final state."
      rationale: "Scroll-scrubbed timelines create continuous motion tied to scroll. High vestibular risk — must remove entirely."

  - id: sectionSequence
    name: Section Sequence
    description: "Section 1 exits then Section 2 enters (choreographed)"
    technique: "CSS scroll-driven + animation-range"
    trigger: "scroll-position"
    lenis_pattern:
      description: "Lenis smooth scroll for CSS scroll-driven section sequences"
      velocity_config:
        lerp: 0.1
        duration: 1.2
        smoothWheel: true
      integration: |
        // Lenis smooths the scroll input that drives CSS animation-timeline: scroll()
        // This prevents jittery section transitions on high-DPI trackpads
        const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.1, duration: 1.2, smoothWheel: true, autoRaf: true })

        // CSS handles the animation binding — Lenis only normalizes scroll behavior
        // .section { animation-timeline: scroll(); animation-range: entry 0% cover 50%; }

        // Velocity data for optional JS-driven enhancements
        lenis.on("scroll", ({ velocity, progress }) => {
          // progress: 0-1 document scroll position
          // velocity: px/s for optional intensity scaling
        })
      benefits:
        - "Consistent scroll feel across browsers for CSS scroll-driven animations"
        - "Prevents scroll jank that disrupts animation-range timing"
        - "Progress data enables synchronized JS effects alongside CSS scroll-driven"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static — both sections visible in final state, no scroll-driven choreography. Standard document flow."
      rationale: "Scroll-driven section transitions involve spatial movement. Remove to prevent vestibular discomfort."

  - id: heroToContent
    name: Hero to Content
    description: "Hero parallax out while content reveals below"
    technique: "GSAP pin + scrub"
    trigger: "scroll-position"
    lenis_pattern:
      description: "Lenis smooth scroll + velocity data for hero-to-content parallax transition"
      velocity_config:
        lerp: 0.08
        duration: 1.4
        smoothWheel: true
      integration: |
        // Lenis with slightly slower lerp for hero sections (more cinematic feel)
        const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.08, duration: 1.4, smoothWheel: true, autoRaf: true })
        lenis.on("scroll", ScrollTrigger.update)

        // GSAP hero-to-content with Lenis-smoothed scroll
        const tl = gsap.timeline({
          scrollTrigger: {
            trigger: ".hero",
            start: "top top",
            end: "bottom top",
            scrub: 1,
            pin: true
          }
        })
        tl.to(".hero-title", { y: -100, opacity: 0 })
          .to(".hero-bg", { yPercent: -30, scale: 1.1 }, "<")

        // Velocity-based parallax intensity
        lenis.on("scroll", ({ velocity }) => {
          const intensity = Math.min(Math.abs(velocity) / 800, 1)
          // Optional: modulate parallax speed based on scroll velocity
        })
      benefits:
        - "Cinematic feel with slower lerp (0.08) for hero sections"
        - "Eliminates scroll jank during pin + parallax transition"
        - "Velocity data enables dynamic parallax intensity"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Static — no pin, no parallax. Hero and content in standard document flow. Content visible below hero immediately."
      rationale: "Parallax + pin + scrub is high-complexity scroll-driven motion. Must remove entirely for vestibular safety."

  - id: listReorder
    name: List Reorder
    description: "Items reposition with layout animation"
    technique: "Framer Motion layoutId"
    trigger: "state-change"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Instant reposition — items snap to new positions with no animated transition. layout: false in Framer Motion."
      rationale: "List reorder is functional (communicates state change). Reduce to instant swap to maintain context without spatial motion."

# =============================================================================
# LAYER 5: PAGE CHOREOGRAPHY (route transitions)
# =============================================================================
page_choreography:
  - id: crossFade
    name: Cross Fade
    description: "Default page transition via View Transitions API"
    technique: "View Transitions API (startViewTransition)"
    browser_support: "90.54% (same-document)"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "reduce"
      fallback: "Instant crossfade with 50ms opacity transition. No spatial movement — opacity-only swap."
      rationale: "CrossFade is the safest page transition (opacity only). Reduce duration to near-instant but keep the visual continuity cue."

  - id: sharedElement
    name: Shared Element
    description: "Shared element morph between views"
    technique: "ViewTransition name + layoutId"
    browser_support: "90.54%"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Instant page swap — no shared element morph. New page appears immediately without spatial transition."
      rationale: "Shared element involves spatial movement (position + scale morph). Remove to prevent vestibular discomfort."

  - id: directional
    name: Directional
    description: "Slide-in-forward/slide-in-back based on navigation direction"
    technique: "View Transitions API with directional classes"
    browser_support: "90.54%"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Instant page swap — no directional slide. New page appears immediately without spatial transition."
      rationale: "Directional slide involves full-page spatial movement. Remove entirely — no safe reduction possible."

  - id: morph
    name: Morph
    description: "SVG path morph between pages"
    technique: "GSAP MorphSVGPlugin"
    browser_support: "GSAP (all browsers)"
    reduced_motion:
      strategy: "remove"
      fallback: "Instant page swap — no SVG morph. New page appears immediately without shape transition."
      rationale: "SVG path morph is decorative and involves complex spatial transformation. Remove entirely."

# =============================================================================

  motion_tokens: "DTCG JSON + Style Dictionary v4"
  css_animations: "CSS Scroll-driven (scroll(), view()) — 82.81% support"
  react_animations: "Framer Motion 12.x (Motion)"
  scroll_choreography: "GSAP ScrollTrigger"
  smooth_scroll: "Lenis"
  page_transitions: "View Transitions API — 90.54% support"
```
